sentences.en: I expect you realised that without being conscious of it.
sentences.zh: 我预计你已经意识到这一点，但并没有意识到。

sentences.en: I was not conscious of a man looking at me.
sentences.zh: 我没有注意到有人在盯着我看。

sentences.en: She was conscious of being stared at by a stranger.
sentences.zh: 她感觉到一个陌生人一直在盯着自己看。

senses.zh: 意识到的，神志清醒的，意识到的，自觉的，有意的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：con（共同）+sci（知道）+ ous（…的）→都知道该怎么做→自觉的
